# Dimension: Interaction Interfaces

Covers how a person drives each harness: TUI, web UI, desktop app, chat
gateway, OpenAI-compatible API, and server/client modes. The focus is whether
the interface can run separately from the place the agent executes, and what
authentication is on by default. Sources are in [citations.md](../citations.md).

## Interface table

| # | Harness / surface | Start | Default bind / port | Auth by default | Browser / phone |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hermes API server (OpenAI-compatible) | `API_SERVER_ENABLED=true` + `API_SERVER_KEY` | 127.0.0.1:8642 [6] | Bearer key required, "including the default loopback bind" [6] | Open WebUI or any OpenAI-format client [6][7][20] |
| 2 | Hermes web dashboard | `hermes` dashboard | 127.0.0.1, no login; non-loopback "engages the auth gate" [13]. Docker image: 0.0.0.0:9119, fails closed without an auth provider [10] | Loopback: none. Non-loopback: required [10][13] | Browser |
| 3 | Hermes Telegram gateway | `hermes gateway` | Outbound polling | Docs: deny-by-default [8][9]. Open issue says fail-open [17] | Telegram app |
| 4 | OpenHands Agent Canvas (local) | npm / Docker [44] | README: npx/npm listeners "bind loopback only (127.0.0.1)" [47]; issue reports published npm 1.24.0 binding all interfaces [56] | Session key auto-injected on loopback [47] | Browser |
| 5 | OpenHands Agent Canvas (Helm) | `helm install` | ClusterIP | "unauthenticated, single-tenant" [45] | Browser via your own authenticating proxy |
| 6 | OpenHands CLI `web` (unmaintained) | `openhands web` | 0.0.0.0:12000 [48] | None documented [48] | Browser |
| 7 | opencode `serve` / `web` / `attach` | `opencode serve` | 127.0.0.1:4096; `--mdns` sets 0.0.0.0 [60][61] | Optional basic auth via `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`; "If… not set, the server will be unsecured" [61] | `opencode web`; Open WebUI Computer [21] |
| 8 | opencode v2 pairing | `opencode pair` | Loopback link | Single-use link, expires in 5 minutes [69] | Browser |
| 9 | Goose remote server | `goose serve` | Not stated; example `--host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --tls` [81][83] | `GOOSE_SERVER__SECRET_KEY` required unless `--dangerously-unauthenticated` [83] | Goose Desktop client [81] |
| 10 | Codex app-server | `codex app-server` | stdio default; WebSocket "experimental and unsupported" [94] | Non-loopback WebSocket unauthenticated by default; `--ws-auth` opt-in [94] | ChatGPT desktop host on macOS/Windows only [95] |
| 11 | Claude Code Remote Control | `claude remote-control` | No inbound port: "outbound HTTPS requests only" [110] | claude.ai login; "API keys are not supported" [110] | claude.ai/code, iOS/Android apps [110] |
| 12 | Claude Code Channels | `claude --channels plugin:telegram@…` | MCP plugin, needs Bun [111] | Pairing code + allowlist [111] | Telegram |

All six also have a terminal interface. For Hermes it is `hermes` [1], for
opencode `opencode` [60], for Goose the CLI and a TUI in beta [82], and for
Codex and Claude Code their CLIs [91][103]. For OpenHands it is the unmaintained
CLI [41].

## Details

### Hermes: API server + Open WebUI

- "The API server exposes hermes-agent as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.
  Any frontend that speaks the OpenAI format — Open WebUI, LobeChat, LibreChat,
  NextChat, ChatBox… can connect" [6].
- "API_SERVER_KEY is required for every deployment, including the default
  loopback bind on 127.0.0.1" [6]. A profile without its own key "fails closed"
  [6].
- "The API server gives full access to hermes-agent's toolset, including
  terminal commands" [6]. "Tool calls run where that API server is running" [7].
  The browser front end can run elsewhere while execution stays inside the Hermes
  host.
- When Open WebUI runs in Docker, point it at
  `http://host.docker.internal:8642/v1` [20]. Open WebUI's first user becomes
  admin [7].
- NemoClaw's Hermes quickstart forwards the dashboard on 18789 and the API on
  8642, both bound to 127.0.0.1, and recommends SSH `-L` tunnels [22]. This
  dashboard port differs from the 9119 in the Hermes Docker docs [10]; both are
  reported as stated. The separate Hermes Webapp uses port 9120 [4].
- Hermes desktop packages exist for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows only [11].

### Hermes: Telegram gateway, a contradiction

- Docs: "By default, the gateway denies all users who are not in an allowlist or
  paired via DM" [8], and the gateway "denies all users by default as a safety
  measure" [9]. `GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS` defaults to false [5].
- Issue #77424 (opened 2026-08-03, open, labelled needs-repro and type/security)
  says: "The Telegram gateway fails open by default". It reports finding
  `GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS=true` in the default `.env` template during an
  incident [17].
- Earlier issue #23778 (P0, v0.13.0, closed 2026-05-19) reports unauthorized DMs
  processed even with `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS` set [18].
- The security checklist says "never use GATEWAY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS=true" [12].
- Two Telegram auth defects were reported three months apart. The later one is
  unconfirmed but still open.

### OpenHands

- Agent Canvas Helm: "Agent Canvas is an unauthenticated, single-tenant
  application… with no built-in authentication, user-level role-based access
  control, or tenant isolation" [45].
- Headless mode "always runs in always-approve mode… This cannot be changed"
  [49].

### Codex

- "Non-loopback WebSocket listeners currently allow unauthenticated connections
  by default during rollout, so configure WebSocket auth before exposing one
  remotely" [94].
- Mobile remote access needs a ChatGPT desktop host on macOS or Windows, and
  "you can't set it up from the Codex CLI" [95]. There is no Linux host path in
  fetched sources.

### Claude Code

- Remote Control "connects claude.ai/code or the Claude app for iOS and Android
  to a Claude Code session running on your machine". The session "makes
  outbound HTTPS requests only and never opens inbound ports" [110].
- Requirements: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise. "API keys are not
  supported." [110]
- Remote Control is unavailable on Bedrock, Agent Platform or Foundry, when
  `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at a host other than api.anthropic.com, or when
  `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` or `DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK` is set
  [110]. The reference dev container sets `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`,
  so Remote Control cannot be used there [115].
- Channels deliver Telegram/Discord events into a running session. "Events only
  arrive while the session is open" [111].

### Open WebUI as a common front end

- Open WebUI Computer can front Codex, Claude Code and opencode. "The CLI must
  be installed and logged in on the host running Computer, not on the phone or
  laptop you browse from" [21].
- Inference, not verified: when Open WebUI Computer drives Claude Code through
  the Agent SDK with a subscription login, it may fall under Anthropic's
  third-party restriction [105].

## Counter-evidence: interfaces that shipped without auth

| Harness | Record | What | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| opencode | CVE-2026-22812 (< 1.0.216) | "automatically starts an unauthenticated HTTP server that allows any local process (or any website via permissive CORS) to execute arbitrary shell commands" | [70] |
| opencode | GHSA-c83v-7274-4vgp (< 1.1.10; advisory also says "before 1.10.0") | XSS in the web UI leads to command execution; Critical 9.4 | [71] |
| OpenHands | CVE-2026-122236 (≤ 1.24.0, fixed 1.25.0) | "Landing missing authentication" | [57] |
| OpenHands | Issue #17878 | Agent Canvas session key exposed by an unauthenticated page on an all-interfaces bind | [56] |
| OpenHands | CVE-2026-112346 (SDK < 1.52.0) | Sandbox agent server on 0.0.0.0 with empty `session_api_keys`; 9.8 | [58] |
| Hermes | Carbonato botnet | Attackers install unmodified Hermes on compromised Docker hosts and drive it over Telegram | [127][128] |
| Hermes | June 2026 campaign | "An unauthenticated public dashboard was the entry point for the June 2026 MCP-config persistence campaign" | [10] |

opencode's current docs still describe the password as optional and the server
as "unsecured" without it [61]. Fixing the CVE did not make auth the default.

## Gaps and Limitations

- `goose serve` default host and port are not stated [83].
- Default bind of Agent Canvas on the release carrying the CVE-2026-122236 fix
  is unconfirmed. v1.25.0 (2026-10-06) lists "fix: keep local session keys off
  externally reachable listeners (#17007)", but its link to the CVE is not
  stated [145].
- opencode v2 server auth defaults beyond `opencode pair` are not documented in
  fetched pages [69].
- Hermes Telegram default: docs and an open issue disagree [8][9][17].
